An '''Exhaust Nacelle''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component that regulated thrust for optimal flight performance. [[IR suppressor]]s were employed to help conceal heated exhaust from enemy [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="SWS" />
